title: Webhook & Billing Event Contract

signature.description: Delivery signatures are HMAC-SHA256 over the timestamp-bound material, verified with a closed algorithm allow-list, a key-id requirement, a hex digest shape check, a freshness window, and a best-effort constant-time comparison.
signature.claim_boundary: Timing-attack resistance is not claimed: Dart offers no constant-time primitive. The signing secret is supplied by the caller and is never stored, logged, or serialized.

replay_protection.description: A repeated event reference is refused, and entries older than the freshness window are purged so the guard cannot grow without bound.
replay_protection.claim_boundary: The guard is process-local and in-memory; cross-process or cross-device replay defence is DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.

idempotency.description: Idempotency keys must be opaque handles; a repeated key is refused and its recorded outcome is replayable instead of being re-applied.
idempotency.claim_boundary: Outcomes are held in memory only; durable idempotency storage is DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.

ordering.description: Event sequences must increase strictly, and an incoming sequence is accepted only when it is greater than the last applied sequence.
ordering.claim_boundary: No cross-partition global ordering is claimed; per-stream ordering only.

retry.description: Retry delay is deterministic exponential backoff with a hard cap, and a permanent error is never retried.
retry.claim_boundary: No scheduler executes the retries; this contract only computes the schedule. DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.

reconciliation.description: Local and provider event sets are diffed deterministically; missing and unknown references are reported and never auto-merged.
reconciliation.claim_boundary: No provider event feed is fetched. DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.

audit.description: Every decision is recorded in an append-only, ordered trail whose serialized form redacts the event reference.
audit.claim_boundary: The trail is in-memory only; durable and tamper-evident audit storage is DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.

claim_boundary: This is a local webhook and billing event contract, not a webhook receiver.
No signing secret, digest, event payload, or provider credential is stored, returned, or logged; references are opaque and digests are redacted.
Live delivery, provider event feeds, durable replay and idempotency storage, and tamper-evident audit storage remain deferred. DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.
